title: ADITYA UNIVERSITY OVERVIEW
content:
Aditya University is a premier multidisciplinary institution located at Aditya Nagar, ADB Road, Surampalem, Kakinada District, Andhra Pradesh – 533437.
Accreditations: NAAC A++ Accredited | NBA Tier-1 Accredited.
Establishment: Founded in 1984 under Aditya Academy; Established under the AP Private Universities Act, 2016.
Legacy: 80+ Institutions, 8,000+ Staff, and 80,000+ Students across Andhra Pradesh.
Website: https://www.adityauniversity.in/

title: HISTORY & LEGACY
content: Aditya Academy was founded in 1984 by Dr. N. Sesha Reddy. Aditya Engineering College (AEC) established in 2001. Evolved into Aditya University under AP Private Universities Act 2016. Today it spans 80+ Institutions, 8,000+ Staff, and 80,000+ Students across Andhra Pradesh.

title: VISION, MISSION & CORE VALUES
content:
Vision: To be a globally recognized university through excellence in Education, Innovation, and Sustainable growth.
Mission: Deliver collaborative education to prepare students for global challenges through Transformative learning, a Vibrant research ecosystem, and a Sustainable community.
Core Values: Excellence, Inclusivity & Diversity, Integrity & Ethical Conduct, Global Outlook.

title: HOSTEL & AMENITIES
content:
Aditya University offers Single, Double, Triple, and Quadruple hostel rooms for students.
